feature.label: CoworkingView Workspace Prices
feature.description: An Eclipse view of city-level hot desk, dedicated desk, and private office ranges from the public CoworkingView Price Index. Refresh fetches https://api.coworkingview.com over HTTPS and falls back to a snapshot bundled in the plug-in. No API key and no telemetry. Plug-in code is MIT. Price Index data is CC BY 4.0.
